title: Activity
description: A record of who did what: content and schema changes, logins, file downloads by signed-in users, refused requests and MCP tool calls, each with the user, OAuth client or API key behind it. Browse it under Utilities → Activity. Rows live in tcms-data/.system/activity and survive application updates.

enable.label: Record Activity
enable.help: Master switch. When off, nothing new is recorded. Existing rows stay and can still be browsed until they age out.

retentionDays.label: Keep Activity (days)
retentionDays.help: Rows older than this are deleted, checked once a day. Raise it when you need a longer audit trail; the store grows by roughly a few hundred bytes per row.

mcpAnonymous.label: Record Anonymous MCP Calls
mcpAnonymous.help: Tool calls from AI clients that are not signed in. Off by default: a public MCP server listed in an AI directory can take thousands of anonymous lookups a day. Signed-in callers and API keys are always recorded.
